Placement/grade requirements (verbatim): CS 120: Prerequisites: MassBay placement into a 100-level Math (not MAC) and CS 110, or instructor's permission | CS 205: Prerequisite: Eligible to take a 100-level math course | EN 101: Placement: place into EN 98 through the College's placement process, the English Department's end of semester portfolio assessment, or by completing EN 90 | MA 200: Prerequisite: MA 102 & MA 103T, or MA 104 or permission of instructor | CS 200: Prerequisite: "C" or better in CS 120 | CS 214: Prerequisite: CS 120 or CS 118 | EN 102: Prerequisite: EN 101 | MA 201: Prerequisite: MA 200 | CS 208: Prerequisite: "C" or better in CS 200, or permission of instructor | CS 212: Prerequisite: CS 110 or CS 120 or CS 123 | PY 103: Prerequisite: MA 104; corequisite: MA 200 | CS 225: Prerequisite: CS 200 | MA 210: Prerequisite: MA 201 or equivalent; or permission of instructor | PY 104: Prerequisite: MA 200 and PY 103; corequisite: MA 201 | PY 104: Prerequisite: MA 200 and PY 103; corequisite: MA 201 | PY 104: Prerequisite: MA 200 and PY 103; corequisite: MA 201

Source: official MassBay Community College curriculum sheet 'Computer Science - Associate in Science' for AY '26-'27 (official MassBay file host), cross-checked term-by-term against the official catalog program page (catalog.massbay.edu, Computer Science (AS), catoid=11/poid=1190): identical course list, sequence, and 68/69 total in both. Transcribed 2026-09-30 from the sheet's semester tables; course codes, titles, credits, and per-course prerequisites copied verbatim from the sheet and official catalog course descriptions. Caveats: (1) The sheet prints total credits as 68/69 because the Second Year Semester 2 Program Elective may be 3 or 4 credits (term total 17/18); total_credits is set to 68, the sequence minimum - a 4-credit program elective yields 69. (2) The sheet's 'First Year Semester 1 or 2' flexible block (CT 100 Critical Thinking 3 + Social Science Elective 3, 6 credits total) is modeled as its own term 'Fall Year 1 or Spring Year 1'; the sheet's First/Second Year Semester 1/2 map to Fall/Spring Year 1/2. (3) The Second Year Semester 2 'Humanities Elective 3 or Social Science Elective 3' is a single 3-credit either/or slot (HU-SS-ELECT), documented in its choice note. (4) Program-elective prerequisites vary by course (see choice note). (5) CS 120's catalog prerequisite also requires CS 110 or instructor permission and placement into 100-level math (not MAC); CS 110 is not in this plan. (6) Humanities electives: Art, Communication, English (EN 103 or higher), ESL (ES 100 or higher, up to 6 credits), Film, Foreign Language, Humanities, Literature, Music, Oral Communication, Philosophy, Photography, Sign Language, Theater Arts. Social science electives: Anthropology, Economics, Geography, Government, History, Law, Psychology, Sociology. (7) MassBay graduation competency: quantitative skills demonstrated by a 100-level math course (not MAC) or placement into 200-level math. (8) This program qualifies as an Alternative Transfer Agreement (MassTransfer) with select public MA institutions; MassTransfer info at www.mass.edu/masstransfer.
